dedupe_keys.name: polish road traffic video datasets pedestrians cyclists vehicles and interchanges

description: Polish road traffic video datasets (pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles and interchanges) is a data set deposited in MOST Wiedzy by its authors Łukasz Jeliński, Daniel Bytner. Olsztyn 2019- video data The data contain video traffic data (pedestrian, cyclists, vehicles) registered at 7 intersections. The video camera was installed around bicycle and pedestrian crossings at the intersection. Camera was mounted on 7-meter-high mast. Recording date 14.05.2019. Location of intersections: Sample view of the video material:. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The repository holds 84 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
